description: Defines the IndexDataManager class and related structures for managing index buffer translation in Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: IndexDataManager
classes.description: Manages index buffer translation and streaming for Direct3D rendering.

methods.name: IndexDataManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IndexDataManager with a BufferFactoryD3D.

methods.name: prepareIndexData
methods.description: Prepares index data for rendering, translating and possibly streaming index buffers.

methods.name: streamIndexData
methods.description: Streams index data into a buffer for rendering.

methods.name: getStreamingIndexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a streaming index buffer.
